_readme: Group list for scripts/fb-comment-hunt-daily.js (daily comment-opportunity finder)
AND api/_lib/daily-group5-post-generator.js (the real POSTING target list for the
daily5 group-post pipeline -- generate -> Telegram approve ->
scripts/fb-group5-post-queue.js -> scripts/fb-group-poster.js --post-id).
ONLY the groups verified to carry real conversation on the 2026-09-08 hunt are active.
The big 'agent' groups (108K/85K/31K) are almost pure listing spam -- scanning them
burned most of that day's 25-visit budget for nothing. They live in skip_groups so
nobody re-adds them without reading why.
The POSTING ceiling is NOT here -- it is PLATFORM_DAILY_CAPS.facebook_auto in
scripts/_lib/comment-caps.js (8/day default; ramp only with Heath's sign-off).
SCHEMA (added 2026-09-16, Carter, after a live browser audit of Heath's real
Facebook account disproved 'Boerne Real Estate' and 'Real Estate in Austin TX' --
neither exists under those names, and neither happened to be in THIS file, but
nothing would have caught it if they had been. Every group entry below now carries:
- existence_verified / existence_verified_date: has someone actually loaded this
URL live and confirmed the group is real? scripts/_lib/group-resolvability-check.js
refuses to scan/post to any entry where this isn't true -- see startup check
wiring in fb-comment-hunt-daily.js and daily-group5-post-generator.js.
- acting_identity: which Facebook identity actually interacts with this group --
'page' | 'personal' | 'unverified'. CORRECTED 2026-09-16: the DossieBot-Sage
Chrome profile (shared by fb-comment-hunt-daily.js, fb-comment-opp-poster.js,
AND fb-group-poster.js -- see scripts/_lib/fb-group-access-detect.js) was
confirmed live to be logged in as the PAGE 'Heath Shepard, Realtor with Keller
Williams City View', not Heath's personal profile. Every group in this file is
touched by that same profile, so acting_identity is 'page' throughout -- this
was previously assumed 'personal' off HEATH_FB_NAMES=['Heath Shepard'] in
fb-comment-hunt-daily.js, which is a plausible-looking name match, not a
verified identity. That HEATH_FB_NAMES assumption has NOT been re-audited as
part of this pass -- flagging it here rather than silently leaving stale intel.
- CORRECTED 2026-09-17: the DossieBot-Sage Chrome profile was re-audited and
is now confirmed logged in as Heath's PERSONAL profile
(facebook.com/heath.shepard.75), not the Page -- the 2026-09-16 finding above
no longer reflects the live session. This is the identity we want for groups
(several groups outright block Pages -- see scripts/_lib/fb-group-access-
detect.js's identity_rejected pattern, e.g. Founding Files). All 4 active
groups below are updated to acting_identity='personal' accordingly. Per-group
identity_membership_verified has NOT been re-checked under the personal
profile as part of this correction -- that remains a separate open item.
- identity_membership_verified: has the acting_identity's actual membership/
posting access to THIS SPECIFIC group been confirmed live? Existence being
verified (readable feed) is NOT the same claim -- reading a group's posts does
not prove the posting identity is a member able to post there.
- requires_admin_approval: true | false | 'unknown' -- whether a post/comment
from here needs moderator sign-off before it's actually live.
- verification_note: how/when verified, or why still marked unverified.
Per Heath's explicit instruction: unverified entries stay in the list marked
unverified, never silently deleted -- the list should be honest, not short.

A human moderator removed a comment posted here on 2026-09-10 (not a bot/spam detector -- FB violations page shows 'No violations', Account Quality clean Aug 16-Sep 14, no checkpoint). DO NOT re-add without reading this and getting Heath's sign-off.
